items.heading: Tacos al Pastor
details: Key ingredients: pork, achiote paste, pineapple, dried chilies, corn tortillas
Marinate thin pork slices in achiote paste, dried chilies and pineapple juice.
Cook the pork on a hot griddle or spit until charred at the edges.
Warm small corn tortillas and fill with chopped pork.
Top with diced pineapple, onion and cilantro.

items.heading: Guacamole
details: Key ingredients: ripe avocado, lime juice, onion, tomato, cilantro, chili
Mash ripe avocado with lime juice to the desired texture.
Fold in finely chopped onion, tomato, cilantro and chili.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve fresh with tortilla chips to prevent browning.

items.heading: Chicken Enchiladas
details: Key ingredients: shredded chicken, corn tortillas, red or green enchilada sauce, cheese
Fill soft corn tortillas with shredded chicken and roll them up.
Arrange in a baking dish and cover with enchilada sauce.
Top generously with shredded cheese.
Bake until bubbling and lightly browned on top.
